description: This file serves as the entry point for a ReactJS web application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, includes a CSS stylesheet, imports the main App component, and renders the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' inside a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to allow rendering React components in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
